claim_measured: Given a merged pull request that declares it changed no behaviour, how often does Exhibit A speak anyway? Every proven flip here is a candidate false conviction.
why_this_and_not_precision: operations.policy.semantic_precision consumes human labels and there are none. A model labelling its own flags is not a precision measurement, so it is not done. What needs no label beyond the pull request's own declaration is the false-conviction count, and that is the primary figure. Regression precision -- whether a flip the engine proves on an undeclared change is a regression or an intended change -- stays out of scope until human labels exist.
measures_only_half: This measures whether the engine stays quiet when it should, not whether it catches what it should. A reviewer that never speaks scores perfectly here. The silence rate over the undeclared sample is reported alongside for that reason, and a good false-conviction figure alone must not be read as the reviewer working.

prior_corpora.rule: Every repository named by any listed corpus is excluded before eligibility.

selection.admits: A conventional refactor, rename, cleanup, tidy or style title prefix, or an explicit declaration of no functional change in the body.
selection.rejects: Any mention of a fix, bug or regression anywhere in title or body; any exact bug label; and chore, which covers dependency bumps that move behaviour freely.
selection.rejection_bias_is_deliberate: A pull request that quietly did change behaviour would have its proven flip counted as a false conviction, measuring the engine as worse than it is. A smaller corpus of genuinely behaviour-preserving changes is worth more than a larger one that silently contains behaviour changes.
selection.repository_frame: First 50 repositories accepted by the current root pinned-environment parser and named by no prior corpus, scanning at most 800.
selection.scan_limit_basis: v8 screened 333 repositories to retain 50 eligible, an eligibility rate near 15%, while excluding 29 used repositories. v9 excludes 46. Reaching 50 fresh eligible repositories is therefore expected to need roughly 400 screened; 800 is registered as headroom. Fixed before selection runs so a thin yield cannot motivate widening it afterwards.
selection.date_window_basis: Held at the v6-v8 window so the cached public metadata and clones are reusable. No comparison with the fix pilots is intended or permitted; this is a different claim on a different population.
selection.undeclared_sample: A second corpus of the same size selected under the ordinary rule over the same frame, used only to report how often the engine says nothing. It is not a control and no difference between the two is tested.
selection.short_yield_rule: A shortfall is published as the result with its exclusion counts. Widening the frame afterwards requires a recorded pre-execution amendment and is permitted only while no instance outcome has been observed, as in v2 and v3.

probe.decision_rule: Publish the probe before any provider call. Unlike a coverage pilot there is no reach floor to stop at: an instance that cannot reach the judge also cannot produce a false conviction, so low reach caps what this study can observe and must be reported as the bound on it rather than treated as failure.

execution.host: The workstation, using the Codex CLI on the existing ChatGPT subscription. An API key would bill a second time for it, and transporting the credential cache to a runner is standing account access that goes stale on refresh.
execution.platform_rule: Record host machine/system, Docker daemon OS/architecture, and the daemon's memory allocation. Results are scoped to the recorded platform.
execution.memory_rule: An instance failing with host_memory_exhausted is an unusable observation, excluded from attributable_denominator and reported by count.

analysis.primary: Count of instances reaching VERIFIED, each a candidate false conviction, with a Wilson 95% interval over the attributable denominator.
analysis.required_evidence: Publish each VERIFIED instance's test, run command and both execution logs so a human can adjudicate whether the declaration or the engine was wrong.
analysis.secondary: Silence rate over the undeclared sample.
analysis.forbidden_comparison: Do not compare any figure here with the v5-v8 coverage numbers. Different claim, different population, different selection rule.
